Message:
fix(security): restore repository content removed by malicious commit

Commit 93ab69bf ("chore(release): pin v0.53.0 marketplace source",
committer "Shafqat" -0800, unsigned) deleted about 8,000 files and planted a
.vscode folderOpen task that ran a script disguised as
public/fonts/fa-solid-500.woff2. The Oct 12 remediation removed the payload
but left the repository wiped.

Restore the tree of ff290839, the last legitimate commit (v0.53.0 release
work), verified free of the payload. Worm leftovers in that tree are removed
in a follow-up commit.
